purpose: Observe simulation clocks with explicit observer cost, not claim an uninstrumented wall-clock frequency

criteria_derivation.median_present_extra_seconds: At most one eighth of observed source dt (3.125 ms nominal)
criteria_derivation.p95_present_extra_seconds: At most one half of observed source dt (12.5 ms nominal); diagnostic jitter bound, not solver numeric tolerance
criteria_derivation.negative_differences: Report actual signed difference; do not interpret negative values as speedup causality
criteria_derivation.scope: Matched same-process B-A-A-B calibration, foreground visible unminimized 1280x720, no sampled held mouse buttons. OS/background load not proven absent. Bounds describe CPU Present observation disturbance only.

recording.initial_state: Opaque per-run copies of the same hashed user data; original data read-only
recording.capture_mode: Separate bounded run, one request at resume+18 seconds; no use of capture stall as source/integration dt
recording.reset: Fresh owned process/private hive/private files; each restart new epoch; diagnostic off gaps invalidate continuous trajectories
required_closure: no unmodeled required water API path
raw parameter values and native Unity clock samples

failure_policy: Keep failed evidence. Do not relax these limits based on the acceptance trial. Rework instrumentation or obtain independent justification and a new decision version. No formal G03 trajectory is accepted before this decision passes.
